note: Turkmenistan: no ordinary passport enters without a visa (Uzbekistan's citizens only into the Shavat-Dashoguz border trade zone for 15 days, not modelled); a visa needs a letter of invitation, and the e-Visa portal unveiled on 2 October 2026 doesn't yet take applications. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Turkmenistan
sources.said: Uzbekistan — from November 2025, citizens of Uzbekistan can visit the Shavat-Dashoguz Border Trade Zone without a visa for up to 15 days. ... Starting from 02 October 2026, Turkmenistan has unveiled its new e-Visa portal. ... However, it is currently no possible to register in order to apply for an e-Visa.
